newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU beef intervention said steady.
newsitem.headline: EU beef intervention said steady.

text.p: The European Union's beef management committee accepted tenders for 17,193 tonnes of beef into intervention on Friday, a Commission official said.
The maximum price for all categories of beef was given as 272.5 Ecus per 100 kg, the official added.
Although intervention rose from 13,519 tonnes at the last meeting on February 25, the market is regarded as steady, the official said.
"There has only been a slight increase in the tenders offered and that is normal," the official added.
Intervention rose from 10,321 tonnes on January 14 to 11,033 on both January 28 and February 11.
Intervention normally represents about half the tenders offered.
